summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-03 audit logging at src/design/obs-03-audit-log.md. The design specifies atomic same-transaction audit persistence for successful state-changing API requests, immutable-record guarantees, actor extraction and canonical action naming, null snapshot semantics, failure rollback behavior when audit storage is unavailable, explicit read-only method exclusion, GET /audit filtering and API-06 pagination/ordering contracts, and a full requirement-to-design traceability matrix with concrete module/function and test obligations.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified all OBS-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases (including null snapshots and canceled-token action handling) map to explicit design sections and validation hooks.
